applicability.rationale: The manuscript makes a comparative completion-time claim, so implementation choices relevant to that claim need to be exposed.
The manuscript relies on synthetic pilot evidence and therefore requires claims to remain proportionate to that scope.

evidence_anchor.claim: The methods identify two dashboard layouts, counterbalancing, and paired completion-time analysis, but do not describe the layouts' claim-relevant implementation differences, task specification, or measurement implementation.

remedy.cost_tradeoffs: Adds documentation and protocol-detail work; may require narrowing wording where implementation details cannot support a stronger interpretation.
remedy.minimum_action: Reserve a methods subsection specifying the claim-relevant layout and interaction differences, simulated handover-task protocol, software or artifact versioning, completion-time and navigation-error definitions, and analysis-script decisions.

findings.scholarly_relevance: Without these details, readers cannot determine what was implemented, reproduce the comparison, or assess whether the reported timing difference supports the stated design-level claim.
